checks: Static two-piece on the generic path: Studio thresholds 0-4 pin mental_damage_bonus at zero below 2 and exactly 1/10 at/above 2 with Psychically_2 row evidence; native stat projection pins the DamageUpPsychicallyBase attribute at the strict threshold 2; an actual equipped Sagiri native build reports the set_unconditional_pack contribution (threshold 2, 1/10, Psychically_2 evidence); Studio and native addition give 7/20 for 1/10 + 1/4, not multiplicative; Mental/Psyche isolation holds in both directions; invalid Studio configs (count 5, missing set, unknown set) reject.

Frozen DT_EquipmentSuitData and DT_EquipmentModifyData rows bind the two-piece pack (empty ConditionArray, single additive 0.1 DamageUpPsychicallyBase modifier) and the four-piece buff asset with its 12%/3-stack/6s description.

Four-piece tested hypothesis: exact grant timeline oracles (1220/1340/1460/1460/1460/1340/1220/1100/1220); discard-at-cap falsifier (6.0s probe deals 1340, not 1460; the 3s grant reports unchanged 3/3); independent expiry boundaries at 5.999999/6/7/8s; a multi-hit Normal input grants a single stack; Psyche isolation with live stacks (Psyche hit 1250, Mental hit 1220); off-field delivery uses the wearer's stacks with live expiry and no ally-owned instances; invalid configs and failed admission grant nothing.

Native equipped Mint build binds GearProcConfig::QuietManorMental from the CT_Equipmentbuff curves (0.12/6/3 with unit and drift rejection); the static compiler keeps the four-piece in unresolved_set_buffs with threshold 4, while the live behavior binds through the separate native set-projection path, so the four-piece is never misread as unmodeled.

Fadia A0 full-HP initial burst oracles at levels 1/8 combine native static and live Eternal Waltz bonuses additively (1500, 2590, 2160, 18648/5, 17094/5, 11682/5); asserted in fadia_actions.rs and referenced here, not re-implemented.
decision: Project DamageUpPsychicallyBase (Psychically_2, 0.1 additive, empty ConditionArray) as static mental_damage_bonus on the generic path. DamageUpPsycheBase (elemental PSYCHE zone) stays a separate zone; Quiet Manor never writes it. Four-piece grants are a tested hypothesis: one independent self Mental stack per successful Normal input before same-time hits, discard-at-cap without refresh, per-stack 6s world-time expiry before equal-time hits.
hypothesis_rationale: The description grants a bonus per Basic Attack and gives each stack its own six-second duration. Model one grant per successful Normal input, before that input's hits, regardless of hit count. At the stated cap, discard further grants without changing existing deadlines, consistent with the existing independent-stack model. Source tables establish constants and the buff dependency but do not establish admission timing or replacement-at-cap behavior; these choices remain tested hypotheses.
independent_oracles: Zero/one piece: zero Mental bonus; two/three/four pieces: 1/10 static. Four pieces additionally grant 3/25 per independent stack, up to three stacks for 6s each.
Fadia A0 full-HP level-1 initial burst: HP times [39,12,12,12,12,63]/1000; Mental bypasses DEF and uses common resistance.
Example Mental multiplier: 1 + 1/4 general + 1/10 static Mental + 1/10 live Eternal Waltz = 29/20. Psyche normals receive only 5/4 general, DEF multiplier 1/2 and resistance multiplier 4/5.
At 10000 unbuffed HP, level-1 initial burst is 1500; Eternal Waltz T1 projects 12000 HP and the combined static/live Mental multiplier 6/5 gives 2160. Level-8 total scales identically to 18648/5.
Normal inputs at 0/1/2/3s leave three deadlines at 6/7/8s. The fourth input does not refresh at cap. Mental probes at 5.999999/6/7/8s receive three/two/one/zero live stacks.

With general +25%, static Mental +10% and live Eternal Waltz T1 +10%, three set stacks give multiplier 181/100; after the first stack expires, two give 169/100. No Mental bonus enters Psyche or Mint Anima packets.
limits: Admission timing and discard-at-cap behavior are modeled hypotheses, not verified native animation or stack-replacement rules.
Fadia initial Ultimate remains A0 and exactly full HP; Lilith follow-ups, passive thresholds, healing and redirect remain pending.
Studio set_count declares geometry applicability; native equipped builds retain actual console packing validation. Full acquisition/release availability remains unverified.

The attempted native Fadia/Arachne T1 full-occupancy build with empty substats produces fractional derived HP and rejects before combat under the existing exact-integer build contract. This does not block the quantized Studio Fadia rotation. Return to native Fadia equipped validation only after an evidenced HP quantization policy is implemented.
Multi-hit Normal inputs and ally isolation are tested hypotheses; native multi-target/off-field trigger scope unverified.
scope: Quiet Manor static two-piece Mental bonus (unconditional additive pack, verified on the generic path) and four-piece tested-hypothesis independent Mental stacks (3/25 per Normal input, cap 3, 6s independent expiry) in Studio and actual equipped builds
